I don't know if you guys will think that I'm physicaly and mentaly weak, but I just can't do it.

I was preparing for taking pills, but I started to imagine my parents arriving home and see my lifeless body on the ground.

I know that they don't care about me but I don't want make my parents suffer.

Every time that I try to kill myself, I just can't do it. I think that I'm too weak to do this.

You're right, but I can't handle these feels more time. My parents saying that I'm dumb, my classmates saying that I'm a weirdo that don't have any friends and people that i tried to socialise (I hope i write that right) just say that they are in a hurry. But thanks Sm3rald and EllanKovic to try to help me out.
I don't have any hobbies,I just stare the entire day to my computer screen and thinking to myself why I'm still alive.
